entries.title: Psalms 58:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. Do not destroy. A secret treasure of David. Will you indeed speak righteousness in silence? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?

entries.title: Psalms 58:2
segments: Yes, in heart you work the evil, you weigh the violence of your hands in the land.

entries.title: Psalms 58:3
segments: The wicked are estranged from the womb; [they go] astray from the womb, speaking lies.

entries.title: Psalms 58:4
segments: Their poison [is] like the poison of a snake; like the deaf adder, he stops his ear,

entries.title: Psalms 58:5
segments: which will not listen to the charmer's voice, a skillful caster of spells.

entries.title: Psalms 58:6
segments: O God, break their teeth in their mouth; break out the big teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 58:7
segments: Let them melt away like waters; they run off to them; he bends his arrows, [let them be] as though [they were] cut off.

entries.title: Psalms 58:8
segments: [Let them be] as a snail goes [into] melting; [as] a miscarriage of a woman, they do not see the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 58:9
segments: Before your pots can feel the thorns, whether green or glowing, He shall sweep it away.

entries.title: Psalms 58:10
segments: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance; he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 58:11
segments: And man shall say, Truly, [there is] a reward for the righteous; truly, [there is] a God judging in the earth.
